items.exampleEn: The newspaper refused to print his inflammatory letter.
items.exampleZh: 報社拒絕刊登他那封煽動性的信。

items.exampleEn: Adversity can make a person stronger.
items.exampleZh: 逆境能讓人變得更堅強。

items.exampleEn: Some students' sleep is adversely affected by late-night phone use.
items.exampleZh: 有些學生的睡眠受到深夜滑手機的不利影響。

items.exampleEn: The story follows the success and sudden downfall of a young boxer.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事講述一位年輕拳擊手的成功與突然垮台。

items.exampleEn: The festival reaches its culmination on Saturday night with a big concert.
items.exampleZh: 這個節慶在週六晚上以一場大型音樂會達到最高潮。

items.exampleEn: Honey can crystallize in cold weather.
items.exampleZh: 蜂蜜在冷天可能會結晶。

items.exampleEn: Heat speeds up the decomposition of this chemical.
items.exampleZh: 加熱會加快這種化學物質的分解。

items.exampleEn: The team went on an unstoppable run of ten wins in a row.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍勢不可擋，連贏了十場。
items.glossZh: 勢不可擋的；無法阻止的

items.sentenceEn: Cold weather can adversely affect the growth of young plants.
items.sentenceZh: 寒冷的天氣可能對幼苗的生長造成不利影響。

items.audioEn: Sales of the new phone have been unstoppable; we sold all of them in two days.
items.audioZh: 新手機的銷售勢不可擋，我們兩天就全部賣完了。
options: They all sold in two days

items.sentenceEn: The opening of the new bridge was the culmination of ten years of planning.
items.sentenceZh: 新橋通車是十年規劃的最終成果。

items.sentenceEn: My ideas about the project began to crystallize after the meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 會議之後，我對這個專案的想法開始變得具體。

items.stemEn: Leaves on the ground slowly turn into soil through ____.
items.stemZh: 地上的落葉透過分解，慢慢變成土壤。

items.stemEn: The player's ____ comments angered fans of the other team.
items.stemZh: 那位球員的挑釁言論激怒了對方球隊的球迷。

items.passageEn: Maria started her small fashion brand during a time of great adversity: her savings were gone, and two shops had refused her designs. Bad reviews online can adversely affect a new brand, and one inflammatory post nearly caused her downfall. But Maria kept working with great dedication. Slowly, her ideas crystallized into a simple style that customers loved. Her first big show in Taipei was the culmination of five years of hard work. Today, her success seems unstoppable, and her clothes are sold in shops across the country.
items.passageZh: Maria 是在極大的逆境中創立她的小服飾品牌的：她的積蓄用光了，還有兩家店拒絕了她的設計。網路上的負評可能對新品牌造成不利影響，有一則煽動性的貼文更差點讓她垮台。但 Maria 依然全心投入地工作。慢慢地，她的想法具體成為一種簡單、顧客喜愛的風格。她在台北的第一場大型服裝秀，是五年努力的最終成果。如今，她的成功似乎勢不可擋，她的衣服在全國各地的店裡都買得到。

questions.questionZh: Maria 剛創立品牌時是什麼情況？
options: 已經有很多顧客和店家支持
積蓄已經用光，還被兩家店拒絕
有大公司投資，還開了兩家店

questions.questionZh: 在台北的第一場大型服裝秀代表什麼？
options: 一次免費的電視宣傳機會

referenceEn: He never gives up in the face of adversity.
He never gave up, even in times of adversity.
rubricZh: adversity 是不可數名詞（例如 in the face of adversity、in times of adversity 等）
沒有時間標記，現在式或過去式都可以

items.promptZh: 過度自信最後導致他垮台。
referenceEn: In the end, too much confidence led to his downfall.
Being too confident was his downfall in the end.
rubricZh: downfall 是名詞，表示「垮台、衰敗」（例如 led to his downfall、was his downfall 等）
「過度自信」可寫，例如 too much confidence、being too confident 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
